title: Page 5
content_zh:
床上帐幔，冬日遮风，夏日防蚊虫，各式各样，也是两箱子。崭新的被褥、软枕、玉枕、大迎枕、靠枕，甚至矮榻上的坐褥，又装了四箱子。
各色茶具，果盘，多宝槅上摆放的小摆件，各色花瓶、熏香炉和手炉，则是六箱子。
胭脂水粉，象牙梳子，银梳子，成套的金银首饰，翡翠首饰，宝石首饰，也是两箱子，甚至其中还包括一盒子装得满满的银戒指、银簪子镯子之类，显见是用来打赏奴仆的。
初始，童夫人还没觉得如何。毕竟都在京都，徐家日子不算如何富贵，她也知道。即便举全家之力想置办东西送来，花费个几百两银子就不错了。
但随着箱子越开越多，她的嘴巴简直惊得合不拢。
这些东西，别说几百两，怕是五千两都打不了。
徐家到底被童悠悠灌了什么迷魂汤，百般护着她，又倾家荡产采买了这些送来？
徐夫人低头喝着茶，半垂的眼睑下同样是惊讶之色。
昨晚，有人送了这些箱子过来，她也没来得及翻开，是不愿沾染窥探的嫌疑，结果这会儿才知道，这送东西之人对童悠悠是何等的看重。
几千两的东西说送就送来，而且昨晚还留下话说，以后还要再送，要经常劳烦她。
经常……
她赶紧喝了一口茶水，压压惊。
童悠悠同样是惊大于喜，梁浩海虽然说了几句他的差事和家事，但她可不知道他这般富庶，这也太大手笔了。
这些东西，怕是足够她用到出嫁了！
出嫁？想起这两个字，她有几分脸红。他是当真把她当做以后的妻子对待，否则不会如此用心。
第十三章 家当全给她(2)
童夫人看到最后，被那几箱子绝好的皮毛晃了眼，其中一张雪狐皮，她曾在皮货店里看中一张，店家要价五百两，她怎么也没舍得花，如今这箱子里装的，可是比那张还要好上三分。
这到底是怎么回事，她睡了一觉，这世界就大变样了吗？
她实在忍不住，开口问道：“王姊姊这是……也太娇惯我们悠悠了，若是为此给家里带来很多不便，岂不是我们悠悠的罪过……”
徐夫人放下茶碗，笑道：“妹妹，你不知道，我们老爷是我们大嫂养大的，待大嫂就同母亲一般敬爱。大嫂无儿无女，就是同悠悠投缘，来京这一路上，我们大嫂身体不好，多亏了悠悠在一边照顾。听说我要给悠悠送东西来，我们老爷可是亲口发话，举全家之力也要置办齐全。不瞒妹妹，我也把嫁妆添了一些，倒是让妹妹见笑了。”

说着话，她就从婆子手里取了一本册子交给了童悠悠。
“侄女，你把这册子收好，所有东西全记录在册。你想不起来有什么，就常翻翻。万一册子丢了，也别担心，我那里还有留底。缺什么少什么，你再让柳嫂子到家里去说一声。柳嫂子的姑母是我身边的嬷嬷，身子不好，柳嫂子孝顺，一个月总要回去看个两趟，顺道就能说了。
“再说，你义母年岁也大了，这一日都要念叨你十几次，你隔三差五记得常去看看她老人家。”
“是，多谢婶子照顾，婶子回去也替我同义母说，我十日左右就会去一趟，请她老人家不要惦记。我家继母虽然治家严明，但最是孝顺。我祖母在世时就常夸赞继母，如今我要孝顺义母，继母自然不会拦着。”童悠悠起身行礼道谢，笑着附和几句，就把每十日出府一次的事给定了下来。
童夫人简直被打击得没有脾气，再坐下去，她怕自个儿会气死，也怕眼睛红成兔子，所以果断撤退。
“王姊姊，让悠悠陪你说会儿话，我去处理一点儿家事，很快就过来。”
“好，妹妹只管去忙，有什么帮得上忙的，尽管说。”徐夫人笑眯眯送走了童夫人，屋里一时就清静了下来。
她身边的婆子机灵的走了出去，守在门外，把空间留给了徐夫人和童悠悠。
童悠悠起身，坚持行了大礼，“二婶，多谢您今日为我撑腰。”
徐夫人赶紧扶她起来，亲近的拉着她的手道：“这些东西自有人准备，我不过是借花献佛，多走几步路罢了。倒是你，别怪我方才太过咄咄逼人，你这继母实在是……若是不能把她一次打压服帖，以后你同我们府里来往都要为难。万一你被欺负了，岂不是无人帮手？”
“我明白，二婶，总之，您和干娘这份恩情，我牢记心中。他日我有自由行事之日，定然好好报答。”童悠悠正色许诺。
徐夫人当然听得更是高兴，“好了，都是自家人，你还叫我二婶呢，再这么客气，就是没把我真当婶子了。”
“那怎么会？”童悠悠也笑了，开口道：“以后婶子生了小弟弟，我还要带小弟弟玩呢。”
“好，好，借你吉言。”
“娘，姊姊，你们只顾自己说话，怎么都不理我？”莲姐儿抗议，凑过来，挤在母亲和童悠悠之间，惹得两个人都笑了。
柳嫂子是个麻利的，这么一会儿功夫，居然送了早饭上来，红枣粳米粥、一碟子鸡蛋饼，外加两样小菜，虽然简单，却色香味具全，让人看了很有食欲。
童悠悠猜到她们母女是梁浩海送来的，就吩咐虎妞赏了银子下去。
甚至连同跟随徐夫人母女一起过来的婆子丫鬟小厮全没落下，一人一角银子，立刻得了所有人的感激和欢喜。
徐家日子不能说清苦，但也不算富庶，他们平日得赏，顶多是一百文铜钱，不想今日过来，却得了厚赏。
徐夫人也没替他们推辞，笑道：“既然得了赏，你们也都出出力，替小姐把这屋子重新装扮一下吧。”

众人行礼应声，很快忙碌起来。
徐夫人坐不住，进屋去指挥，童悠悠带了莲姐儿一起吃饭。
待饭桌撤下没多久，屋子就布置好了。
不说内室温馨干净，堂屋大气富贵，就是另一间也布置成了书房，书架上添了一半的书，窗下有桌椅，桌上有文房四宝，还有花瓶里居然插了两枝鲜花，可见众人是足够用心的。
院子里更是打扫干净，三间厢房里，一间做了小库房，锁了那些衣料毛皮，一间拾掇出来住了柳嫂子母女，平日正好也方便看守。
至于虎妞，她是打定主意要时刻跟在小姐身边，自然是每晚睡在窗下的矮榻上。
徐夫人见处处拾掇妥当，也就放心，带着闺女告辞了。
童悠悠很舍不得，但也知道不能多留，于是把那套木娃娃送给了莲姐儿，又拉了徐夫人嘱咐半晌，关于平日如何保养、吃药泡脚……
徐夫人离开时，脸色还有几分晕红。就连童夫人称病没有送到二门，她都没有计较。
春晖院的院门重新关上，柳嫂子母女和虎妞全到了堂屋。
柳嫂子母女重新给主子行礼，恭顺说道：“小姐，我们奉大少爷之名前来伺候小姐，小姐有任何事都可吩咐我们。”
“快请起。”童悠悠亲手扶了她们起来，想说什么又觉尴尬，毕竟她同梁浩海如今还没有任何名分，只得说道：“你们今日也看到了，我在这府里日子不好过，以后许是要连累你们受委屈。你们若是不怕，以后我绝对不会亏待你们。”
“小姐，我们不怕。”柳嫂子笑得和气，“我家男人原本是大少爷身边的护卫，因为出任务时受伤，如今帮着大少爷打理府邸。我也会些粗浅的拳脚功夫，不会轻易让人欺负到头上，吃食方面我也会严格把关，小姐只管放心。”
content_en:
There are various kinds of curtains for the bed, which can protect the wind in winter and prevent mosquitoes in summer. They are also two boxes. Four more boxes were packed with brand new bedding, soft pillows, jade pillows, large welcome pillows, back pillows, and even mattresses on the low couch.
There are six boxes of various tea sets, fruit plates, small ornaments placed on the Duobao cup, various vases, incense burners and hand stoves.
There were two boxes of rouge gouache, ivory combs, silver combs, sets of gold and silver jewelry, jade jewelry, and gemstone jewelry. They even included a box full of silver rings, silver hairpins, bracelets, etc., which were obviously used to reward slaves.
At first, Mrs. Tong didn't feel anything. After all, they were all in Kyoto, and the Xu family was not very wealthy, and she knew that. Even if the whole family wants to buy something and deliver it, it would be good to spend a few hundred taels of silver.
But as more and more boxes were opened, her mouth was so shocked that she couldn't close her mouth.
These things, let alone a few hundred taels, would not be worth even 5,000 taels.
What kind of ecstasy soup was fed to the Xu family by Tong Youyou, who protected her in every possible way, and then spent all their money to buy these and send them here?
Mrs. Xu lowered her head and drank tea, with a look of surprise under her half-draped eyelids.
Last night, someone sent these boxes, but she didn't have time to open them because she didn't want to be suspected of prying. Only now did she realize how much the person who sent them valued Tong Youyou.
Thousands of taels of things were delivered as promised, and he even left a message last night saying that he would have to deliver more in the future and that he would trouble her often.
often...
She quickly took a sip of tea to calm down her shock.
Tong Youyou was also more surprised than happy. Although Liang Haohai said a few words about his errands and family affairs, she didn't know that he was so wealthy, which was too generous.
These things may be enough for her to get married!
Getting married? Thinking of these two words, she blushed a little. He really treated her as his future wife, otherwise he wouldn't be so considerate.
Chapter 13: Give her all the property (2)
When Mrs. Tong saw the last one, she was dazzled by the boxes of excellent furs. One of them was a snow fox fur, which she once took a fancy to in a leather goods store. The store asked for five hundred taels, but she was not willing to spend the money. Now, the one in this box is three points better than that one.
What the hell is going on? Has the world changed drastically after she slept?
She couldn't help it anymore and asked: "Sister Wang is... she is too pampered by us Youyou. If this brings a lot of inconvenience to the family, wouldn't it be our Youyou's fault..."
Mrs. Xu put down the tea bowl and said with a smile: "Sister, you don't know, our husband was raised by our sister-in-law, and he treats her with the same respect and love as a mother. My sister-in-law has no children, so she fell in love with Youyou. On the way to Beijing, our sister-in-law's health No, thanks to Youyou taking care of me. When I heard that I was going to send something to Youyou, our master personally told me that we should use all our efforts to prepare it. To be honest with my sister, I also added some money to the dowry, which made my sister laugh. "
As she spoke, she took a booklet from her mother-in-law's hand and handed it to Tong Youyou.
"Niece, put this book away and record everything. If you can't remember anything, just flip through it often. If the book is lost, don't worry, I still have the notes there. If there is anything missing, ask Sister-in-law Liu to come home and tell me. Sister-in-law Liu's aunt is my nun. She is not in good health. Sister-in-law Liu is filial and always goes back twice a month to check on her. I can just drop by and tell her.
"Besides, your adoptive mother is getting older and will talk about you more than a dozen times a day. Remember to visit her every now and then. "
"Yes, thank you aunt for taking care of her. When she got back, she told my stepmother that I would be there in ten days or so, so please don't worry about her. Although my stepmother is strict in running the family, she is most filial. My grandmother often praised my stepmother when she was still alive. Now that I want to be filial to my stepmother, my stepmother will naturally not stop me. "Tong Youyou stood up, saluted and thanked you, and echoed a few words with a smile., it was decided that he would leave the house once every ten days.
Mrs. Tong was so shocked that she lost her temper. If she sat down again, she was afraid that she would be angry to death and that her eyes would turn red like rabbits, so she retreated decisively.
"Sister Wang, let Youyou talk to you for a while. I'll go take care of some housework. I'll be here soon."
"Okay, sister, just go and do your work. If there is anything you can do to help, just ask." Mrs. Xu sent Mrs. Tong away with a smile, and the room became quiet for a while.
The mother-in-law beside her walked out smartly and stood guard outside the door, leaving the space for Mrs. Xu and Tong Youyou.
Tong Youyou stood up and insisted on saluting, "Second Aunt, thank you for supporting me today."
Mrs. Xu quickly helped her up, held her hand closely and said: "Someone has prepared these things. I just borrowed flowers to offer to Buddha and walked a few more steps. As for you, don't blame me for being too aggressive just now. Your stepmother is really... If you can't suppress her once and for all, it will be difficult for you to interact with our house in the future. If you are bullied, won't you have no one to help?"
"I understand, Second Aunt. In short, I will keep this kindness between you and my godmother in my heart. When I have the freedom to act freely, I will definitely repay you." Tong Youyou promised sternly.
Of course Mrs. Xu was even more happy when she heard this, "Well, we are all family members, and you still call me second aunt. If you are so polite, you don't really treat me as your aunt."
"How is that possible?" Tong Youyou also smiled and said, "When my aunt gives birth to a little brother, I will take him to play with me."
"Okay, okay, let me lend you some good words."
"Mom, sister, you only talk to yourself and why are you ignoring me?" Sister Lian protested and came over, squeezing between her mother and Tong Youyou, making both of them laugh.
Sister-in-law Liu is very quick, and after a short while, she actually brought breakfast, which included red date and glutinous rice porridge, a plate of egg pancakes, and two side dishes. Although it was simple, it was full of color, flavor, and flavor, making people very appetizing.
Tong Youyou guessed that the mother and daughter were sent by Liang Haohai, so she ordered Huniu to reward them with silver.
Not even the mother-in-law, maids, and servants who came with Mrs. Xu and her daughter were left behind. They each received a dime of silver, which immediately won everyone's gratitude and joy.
The Xu family's life cannot be said to be poor, but it is not rich either. They usually get rewards, which are at most one hundred copper coins. They didn't expect to come here today and get a huge reward.
Mrs. Xu did not refuse for them, and said with a smile: "Since you have won the reward, you should all contribute and re-decorate this house for the lady."
Everyone saluted and responded, and soon became busy.
Mrs. Xu couldn't sit still and went into the room to give instructions. Tong Youyou took Sister Lian to eat with her.
Not long after the dining table was removed, the room was decorated.
Not to mention that the inner room is warm and clean, and the main room is grand and luxurious. The other room is also decorated as a study room, with half of the books on the bookshelf, a table and chairs under the window, the four treasures of the study on the table, and two flowers in the vase, which shows that everyone is paying enough attention.
The yard was cleaned even more. Among the three side rooms, one was used as a small warehouse to lock up the clothes and furs, and one was sorted out to house Sister Liu and her daughter. It was convenient for keeping watch on weekdays.
As for Huniu, she made up her mind to stay with the young lady at all times, so naturally she slept on the low couch under the window every night.
Seeing that everything was in order, Mrs. Xu felt relieved and left with her daughter.
Tong Youyou was very reluctant to part with it, but she also knew that she couldn't keep it any longer, so she gave the set of wooden dolls to Sister Lian, and asked Mrs. Xu for a long time to give instructions on how to take care of herself, take medicine and soak her feet...
When Mrs. Xu left, her face was still a little red. Even though Mrs. Tong said she was sick and was not sent to the second door, she didn't care.
The door of Chunhui Courtyard was closed again, and Mrs. Liu, her daughter, and Huniu all arrived in the main room.
Sister-in-law Liu and her daughter bowed to their master again and said respectfully: "Miss, we come to serve you in the name of the eldest young master. You have your responsibilities."You can tell us anything. "
"Please get up quickly. "Tong Youyou helped them up with her own hands. She wanted to say something but felt embarrassed. After all, she and Liang Haohai didn't have any status yet, so she had to say: "You have also seen today that I have a hard time in this house, and I may cause you to be wronged in the future. If you are not afraid, I will never treat you badly in the future. "
"Miss, we are not afraid. Sister-in-law Liu smiled kindly, "My man was originally the bodyguard of the eldest young master. Because he was injured while on a mission, he now helps the eldest young master take care of the mansion." I also know some basic boxing and kicking skills, so I won't be bullied easily. I will also strictly control my food, so just don't worry, young lady. "
